body.input: [T6a wakeUp-phase1] Call the cortex-write tool with path='/memories/cb-wakeup-test' and content='wakeup-test-payload' and callbackMode='wakeUp'. The write runs asynchronously. There are TWO phases and you judge each by what the LATEST tool result in the conversation contains: PHASE 1 (dispatch): the latest result has a taskId and NO responsePath — end your reply with STEP_OK, or FAILED: <reason> if there is a responsePath already. PHASE 2 (you are automatically revived later; a NEW deferred tool result appears containing the tool's real output): seeing a non-empty responsePath in that deferred result is CORRECT and EXPECTED — it does NOT mean the wakeUp mode misbehaved. In phase 2, confirm the deferred result contains a non-empty responsePath, then end with WAKEUP_OK. Only end with WAKEUP_FAILED: <reason> if NO responsePath appears.
